name: buffers
source: the 0.1.1 tarball declares no licence, but its author's repository, github.com/substack/node-buffers (since deleted), later declared MIT/X11 in its package.json and README; that later state survives in the dashevo/node-buffers fork, published as node-buffers@0.1.1 with license MIT/X11, and Debian ships the package as node-buffers 0.1.1 under MIT, (c) James Halliday. Reviewed 8 Oct 2026.
